descriptions.text: War Crime. As this spell is unable to be properly trained, it will start at level 5, and it will increase by 5 each time it is cast. Type: Atrocity. Target: A line-of-sight beam extending from caster’s eyes that shoots in a narrow cone. Area of effect: See description. Cost: 1 mana point. Duration: See description. Cooldown: This spell can only be cast once per floor, and it can only be cast on the Scolopendra Levels, meaning levels 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, and 18. It can only be cast a total of 3 times. This spell has been cast 0 times so far. …

recap.text: Donut opens a Legendary 1914 box and gets War Crime, a spellbook that bleeds and cries. With the Nest at 8% health and Lucia Mar's net keeping Donut in the tower, Carl tells her to cast it, anything but fire. She commits a third Atrocity and becomes The Oak Fell, Champion of Nekhebit. A glowing cat's paw slams thousands of soldiers and the god Meatus through Li Na's chains, dozens of times.

Donut finds two Celestial boxes from her War Crime spell, a slap-chop box and a godslayer box. The smoky godslayer box forms into the shape of Meatus as a smoky paw slams down on it, and leaves no physical reward. Donut's forward right paw begins to glow, and Mordecai says he knows what this is. Asked which three spells she would combine in a second casting, she says nothing is off the table, but not before the twelfth floor.

beats.headline: Bleeding and crying
beats.text: Carl is taking in a rare moment of silence, still processing what happened when they confronted D'Nadia, when two messages arrive at once. Donut has opened her 1914 box and got a spellbook called War Crime. She is not sure whether she should read it. The book itself is bleeding and crying, and it is disgusting. The other message is Florin, falling back as the enemy finally shows its armor, and then the trap notifications start.
beats.gist: Donut opens her 1914 box and finds War Crime, a bleeding, crying spellbook, as Florin reports traps.

beats.headline: Built into the Nest
beats.text: When they built the Nest tower they could assign its synergy to several skills, spells and classes. A straight-up sniper tower was the first idea, but Donut's tiara made that unnecessary, so the Nest was built instead to have synergy with something called Atrocity-class spells. Donut has several, including her new one, War Crime. It is the one part of the day's plan Carl prays they will not have to use.
beats.gist: Donut's Nest tower is built for Atrocity-class spells, including War Crime, which Carl prays they will not use.

beats.headline: An act of fiendish cruelty
beats.text: In a note to the Cookbook, Carl writes that he used an old dictionary in the guildhall to look up Atrocity: an act of fiendish cruelty. Perhaps the definition is right and the system is wrong to call Donut's War Crime spell one; or perhaps the true act of fiendish cruelty was giving her the spell at all. It came in the Legendary 1914 box they received after killing D'Nadia, the same box as his Run, Little Günter, Run. For the first time he prays a plan of his own will not succeed.
beats.gist: Donut's Atrocity spell came in the same Legendary 1914 box as Carl's Run, Little Günter, Run.

beats.headline: Two spells and a finisher
beats.text: Rosetta changes the plan: Bijanbi, a Dinner Bell variant from a cleric who fell defending the FUPA, and Wall of Fire, both amplified by War Crime, to drag the enemies out and drop them into a ring of fire, with the fleshers as the finisher, because War Crime keeps its victims alive. Carl has the spell's extra-long description in his scratch pad. It starts at level 5, combines two spells in a creative way, can be cast once a floor and only on the Scolopendra levels, knocks the caster to 1% health, and cannot kill anyone directly. They will want to die. They won't.
beats.gist: Rosetta amplifies Bijanbi and Wall of Fire with War Crime, keeping enemies alive for the fleshers.

beats.headline: Anything but fire
beats.text: The Nest is at 8% health, and a net Lucia Mar left behind keeps Donut from leaving the tower. Carl wants to abort, but Li Na says it is a little late for that: the ball is about to break. Donut, don't cast War Crime, Carl shouts, but she has to cast the moment it breaks, or everyone will be mixed in together, the gods included. If she does not cast it, Donut says, all of this will be for nothing. Cast it, Carl tells her, but don't pick fire; the Nest has to stay intact. Anything but fire. The ball has broken, Li Na says. Cast now!
beats.gist: Carl tells Donut to cast War Crime when the ball breaks: anything but fire.

beats.headline: The Oak Fell
beats.text: Casting now, Donut shouts. She has committed a third Atrocity, received a new class, and will be called The Oak Fell, Champion of Nekhebit. Her two spells are Bijanbi and Astral Paw. Out of the broken ball, thousands of soldiers and the god Meatus float up in slow motion and bunch beneath an enormous glowing cat's paw while fleshers dissolve them. Li Na builds a lattice of chains below. Trembling in Carl's arms, Donut swipes downward, and the paw slams them through the chains, again and again, dozens of times.
beats.gist: Donut casts her third Atrocity, and a glowing cat's paw slams soldiers and Meatus through Li Na's chains.

beats.headline: Two Celestial boxes
beats.text: Going through her achievements, Donut finds two Celestial boxes from her War Crime spell: a celestial slap-chop box and a celestial godslayer box. The last box to open, the smoky godslayer one, forms into the shape of Meatus as a smoky paw slams down on it, and leaves no physical reward behind. Then Donut stares at her forward right paw, the same paw she used for War Crime, her voice full of fear. Something's happening. The paw glows, and Mordecai says he knows what this is.
beats.gist: Donut finds two Celestial boxes from War Crime; the godslayer box takes Meatus's shape, and her paw glows.

beats.headline: A second casting
beats.text: At a table of goats passing judgment, one of the big ones finds Donut worthy and asks her a question: has she given any thought to which three spells she might combine if she cast War Crime a second time? She stiffens, then composes herself. It will depend on the circumstances, she says. Nothing is off the table, but she won't be able to cast it until the twelfth floor, and she and Carl must first get through the next two.
beats.gist: Donut tells a goat judge she can't cast War Crime again until the twelfth floor, after two more.

relations.note: Rosetta's plan ties the spell in with the bonus from War Crime
